items.description:
The practice has been providing dental care in Cape Town for 38 years and describes its approach as high-tech, high-touch oral care. Its services cover endodontic dentistry, oral hygiene and preventative dentistry, paediatric dentistry, periodontics, prosthetic and restorative dentistry, minor oral surgery and teeth whitening.

The practice also offers guided biofilm therapy, implants and implant-supported crowns, bridges and dentures, rubber dam treatment and X-rays, along with custom appliances such as gumguards, anti-snore devices and bite plates for clenching and grinding. Referrals to dental specialists are arranged where needed. It is based at 1 Milner Road in Tamboerskloof, Cape Town, and suits patients across the family, from children's dentistry to restorative and cosmetic work.

Harry Goemans Garden Centre is a family-run nursery on Kommetjie Road in Sunnydale, supplying plants, pots, fertilisers and garden tools. The range includes a wide selection of indigenous plants and exotic plants suited to the South Peninsula's conditions, along with clay, cement fibre, wood, plastic and decorative ceramic pots and containers.

The business began in 1960 on Main Road in Bergvliet, and the Sunnydale branch opened in 1994. It is now owned and run by a member of the founding family, and the centre's cafe has reopened under the name Cinnamon and Sage. It suits gardeners in Kommetjie and the wider South Peninsula who want plants and materials that suit local conditions.

Mamacita's is a Cal-Mex restaurant on Harrington Street in District Six, bringing the spirit of Los Angeles street food to Cape Town with a Mexican twist. Its kitchen turns out tacos and street-style burgers inspired by the food trucks of East LA, built into a menu its own description calls a nod to the city's culinary diversity.

The drinks list leans into the same West Coast influence, with a cocktail menu of signature drinks, each one crafted to reflect the essence of a different iconic West Coast rapper. The Harrington Street address is the flagship of a small group that also trades on Kloof Street and in Blouberg. It suits diners around District Six and central Cape Town after a casual Cal-Mex meal with a side of LA culture.

MMH Law is a full-service law firm, trading as Marais Muller Hendricks Attorneys, with more than 75 years of experience. The firm's Kuils River branch operates from the Marais Muller Building on Van Riebeeck Road, and the wider practice has around 30 lawyers and 120 support staff.

Offices are in the Cape Town CBD, Tyger Valley, Kuils River and Stellenbosch. The practice areas include litigation, property law and conveyancing, corporate and commercial law, dispute resolution, employment law, administrative law, family law, debt collection, and trusts, wills and deceased estates.

Through its membership of Lawyers Associated Worldwide, the firm gives clients access to more than 4,500 lawyers in over 197 jurisdictions, which is useful for matters that cross borders. It suits residents and businesses in the Kuils River area who want local legal help backed by a larger network.

Muizenberg Medical Square offers comprehensive medical and dental services under one roof on Main Road, with two female dentists and two female doctors on the team. The practice describes a caring, family-centred approach and says it has served the greater Muizenberg community for years.

General consultations with the doctors and dental care from the dentists are both available in the same building, with reception staff to help with bookings and enquiries. Two long-serving doctors have retired after more than 20 years of service to the community. It suits families in Muizenberg and the surrounding False Bay area who want medical and dental care close to home.

NovaMarine supplies and services marine safety and survival equipment from its base at 96 Marine Drive in Paarden Eiland. The range includes lifejackets and accessories, liferafts, lifebuoy rings, signalling and beacons, food and water rations, fire safety equipment, breathing apparatus, survival suits and boat cleaning products.

Its fire safety solutions cover extinguishers, breathing apparatus, hoses and accessories, and its facility is SANAS approved to refill CO2 extinguishers. Technicians are certified to service extinguishers and fire protection systems, and liferaft services are carried out to international quality standards. Calibration and chandlery services are also offered, and customers can shop products online.

Dis-Chem Cape Gate Pharmacy is a branch of the Dis-Chem pharmacy chain, trading from the Cape Gate Shopping Precinct Centre on the corner of Okavango and De Bron Road in Brackenfell. The store has a dispensary, an in-store clinic and a beauty salon, and it offers click and collect and DeliverD delivery for customers who prefer not to visit in person.

The chain has served South Africans since 1978 and is known for the range of its beauty, healthy food, sport supplement and wellbeing categories, with expert advice available in store. Shoppers can also use the Better Rewards programme for discounts across more than 180 brands and save shipping and payment details online. It suits Brackenfell shoppers who want a pharmacy, clinic and beauty services under one roof.

Clearance Warehouse is a clearance depot on Paarden Eiland Road in Paarden Eiland, selling end-of-range, overstocked and discontinued tiles and sanitaryware at reduced prices. Stock changes regularly and has included large-format ranges such as the Alps White, Angola Black and Ario Ultra Icement tile lines, in sizes up to 1000mm by 1000mm, marked down from their usual retail price.

Customers can get in touch by phone or email to check current stock before visiting the showroom, and the site lists both collection and delivery as ways to take purchases home. It suits homeowners, renovators and contractors around Paarden Eiland and greater Cape Town who want tiling and sanitaryware at clearance prices rather than full retail rates.

items.description:
Dilshaad Oosthuizen Physiotherapy is a physiotherapy practice trading from Shop 4 in the Key Shopping Centre on Victoria Road, Grassy Park. Its listed services cover general physical therapy, dry needling and acupuncture, offered as part of a broader holistic-health approach to treatment rather than a single-technique focus, so a treatment plan can draw on more than one of these methods as needed.

The practice is open Monday to Thursday from 10am to 6pm and Friday from 10am to 5:30pm, closed over weekends, and patients can get directions or call ahead to book an appointment before visiting. It suits patients in Grassy Park and the surrounding southern suburbs who are looking for physiotherapy, dry needling and rehabilitation support close to home.

items.description:
Flight Centre Waterstone is a branch of the Flight Centre travel agency network, helping customers plan flights, holidays, tours and cruises, including international trips. Travellers are welcome to walk into the store at any time to speak to a Travel Expert, or to make an appointment in advance if they would rather plan ahead of a visit.

The branch also offers quotes and deals on flight, tour, cruise and holiday packages, with its own seasonal specials highlighted in store. It trades from Shop 42 in Waterstone Village in Somerset West, and is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5:30pm, Saturdays from 9am to 4pm and Sundays from 9am to 1pm, suiting leisure travellers planning anything from a weekend getaway to a custom overseas itinerary.

Food Lover's Market Tokai is a fresh produce and grocery supermarket trading from Shop 5 in Tokai on Main, on Main Road in Tokai. The store runs its own bakery, butchery, deli and fishmonger counters alongside a sushi section, a wine department and a Seattle coffee counter, on top of its usual supermarket grocery range.

The store offers on-site parking and is wheelchair friendly, and it supports local causes through partnerships with the Darun Naim Orphanage and the Westlake United Church Trust. It is open from 9am to 7pm on Mondays, 8am to 7pm Tuesday to Friday, 8am to 6pm on Saturdays and 8am to 4pm on Sundays, serving households around Tokai and the southern suburbs who want fresh produce, meat and prepared food together under one roof.

items.description:
Italtile Cape is a tile and bathroom-supplies showroom trading from the Northgate Estate retail park in Brooklyn, forming part of the national Italtile network of tile and bathroom specialists found across South Africa. The showroom is listed as both a tile store and a bathroom supply store, and past customers have used it for full bathroom and kitchen renovations, sourcing tiles, vinyl flooring and accessories for their homes.

Being part of the wider Italtile group gives the Brooklyn showroom access to a broad range of tiling, sanitaryware and bathroom products beyond what a single independent store would usually carry, while still offering the kind of in-person advice a renovation project calls for. It trades from the Northgate Estate retail park in Brooklyn, Cape Town.

It suits homeowners, renovators and contractors planning a bathroom, kitchen or flooring project who want tiling and sanitaryware options to see and compare in person before they buy.

Kauai Welgemoed Forum is a branch of the KAUAI healthy food chain, serving wraps, salads, smoothies and barista-brewed coffee made from fresh, wholesome ingredients. The menu covers easy on-the-go options alongside all-day breakfast, and vegan choices are available for customers who want a plant-based meal.

Orders can be placed through the KAUAI app for quick collection, and the branch also delivers through Mr Delivery and Uber Eats for customers who would rather eat at home or the office. The format suits people looking for a fast but health-focused alternative to traditional fast food, with dine-in, takeaway, breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner all catered for in one menu. It trades from Shop 11 in Welgemoed Forum on Kommissaris Street, Welgemoed.

It's a good stop for shoppers and nearby office workers wanting a quick, healthier meal without giving up convenience.

items.description:
KFC Mandalay is a branch of the KFC fried-chicken chain, trading from Thembokwezi Square in Mandalay, Khayelitsha, and listed under the fast-food, chicken restaurant, chicken wings restaurant, fried chicken takeaway and meal takeaway categories. The branch serves the chain's usual fried chicken, wings, burgers and other quick-service meals, with options for customers to dine in, take away or collect an order.

Being one of several KFC branches serving the wider Khayelitsha and Mitchells Plain area, it gives local residents a familiar, quick option for a chicken meal without having to travel into town. It trades from Shop 21, Thembokwezi Square, Swartklip Road, in Mandalay, Khayelitsha.

It's a convenient stop for local residents and visitors after a fast, no-fuss chicken meal, whether eating in or taking away.

items.description:
KwikSpar Kromboom is a supermarket trading from Kromboom Gardens on Kromboom Road in Rondebosch East, part of the SPAR group's KwikSpar format of neighbourhood grocery stores. It is listed as a grocery store, supermarket and fruit and vegetable store, and shoppers have described a store that keeps its fresh produce in good condition, with a working cold chain, a bakery section and freshly prepared hot food available to buy.

The branch underwent a renovation that shoppers say improved the store, and visitors note that shelves are kept well stocked with a high standard of hygiene throughout, in keeping with the wider SPAR group's approach to its stores. It trades from Kromboom Gardens on Kromboom Road, Rondebosch East.

It suits local households doing their everyday grocery shopping who want fresh produce, a bakery and hot food on one visit close to home.

items.description:
Medellin Harrington is a gentlemen's grooming and barbering business on Harrington Street in District Six, offering barbering, hair styling, beard trims, head shaves and classic men's haircuts. The parlour is set over two storeys and also offers hot towel shaves, along with manicures, pedicures and massages for clients wanting a fuller grooming visit.

Bookings can be made online, making it straightforward for clients to secure a slot at a time that suits them, and the two-storey setup gives the business room for a fuller range of grooming services than a single-chair barbershop would typically offer. It operates from 99 Harrington Street in District Six, Cape Town.

It suits men looking for a proper barbershop experience, from a quick haircut and beard trim to a longer grooming session with a shave, manicure or massage included.

Molteno Road Dental Practice is a dental practice on Molteno Road in Oranjezicht, offering general and cosmetic dentistry alongside dental implants, periodontal treatment and emergency dental care. The practice is also set up for teeth whitening, including take-home whitening kits that patients can use after an in-practice consultation with the oral hygienist.

Patients have described a caring, thorough practice where oral hygiene treatments such as whitening are carried out step by step and explained clearly along the way. Weighing routine check-ups against more involved cosmetic and implant work gives the practice the range to handle both everyday visits and bigger dental projects. It is based at 12 Molteno Road, Oranjezicht, Cape Town.

It suits patients across Oranjezicht and the surrounding City Bowl who want one dental practice for check-ups, cosmetic treatment, implants and emergencies alike.

items.description:
On the Rocks Restaurant is a seafood restaurant built right on the water's edge in Bloubergstrand, with the waves breaking just below the tables and sweeping views across to Table Mountain, Robben Island and the Cape Town skyline. Diners can also watch ships entering Table Bay, and dolphins and whales are often visible from the restaurant depending on the season.

Inside, the restaurant has a Venetian fireplace decorated with Greek mythology inscriptions, and a separate whiskey and cigar lounge keeps the main dining area smoke-free for other guests. The combination of the setting and the detail that has gone into the interior makes it a popular choice for a special meal rather than a quick bite. It trades from 45 Stadler Road in Bloubergstrand.

It suits local diners and visitors after a memorable waterside meal, particularly around sunset when the views over Table Bay are at their best.

Paranga is a beachfront restaurant in Camps Bay, trading as the flagship venue of the Kove Collection group and serving a Mediterranean-inspired menu of seafood, sushi and grilled dishes. It was first established in 2002, and since then the restaurant has built the relaxed but upmarket character now associated with Camps Bay's beachfront.

The setting is part of the appeal: guests can walk straight off the beach into the restaurant for a long lunch that often runs into an early dinner, with Atlantic views as a backdrop. As part of a larger hospitality group, it also has the backing to handle bigger bookings and private events alongside its everyday beachfront dining. It is based at Shop 1, The Promenade, Victoria Road, Camps Bay.

It suits local diners and visitors wanting a relaxed beachfront lunch or dinner, especially anyone looking to make a full afternoon of it by the water.
